verdict.rationale: Lithic ships an official MCP server that lets an AI agent search docs and execute live API calls in-editor (lithic-docs-1, lithic-docs-14, lithic-probe-3), and a blog post shows an agent workflow creating/assigning cards and configuring Authorization Rules to control spend via that MCP surface (lithic-docs-11). The core issuing API supports card create/update (lithic-docs-9) and program/account/card-level spend controls (lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-13, lithic-docs-17). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of reading balances/transactions through the MCP surface, and documentation of scoped/limited credentials specifically for agent/MCP use (vs. general API keys) — these gaps keep it from a full verdict.
